subtitle: A mild chicken curry with creamy tomato sauce, pilau rice and naan, suited to diners who prefer flavour over heat.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons chicken tikka masala costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with pilau rice and naan bread. The curry combines marinated chicken with a creamy tomato-based sauce and mild aromatic spices. Prices vary by pub, with [Curry Club](/curry-club) pricing on Thursdays, so check your chosen location before ordering.

components.name: Marinated chicken
components.note: Tender pieces of marinated chicken give the curry its main substance, coated in the rich, mildly spiced sauce.

components.name: Creamy tomato sauce
components.note: Tomato, cream and aromatic spices create a velvety sauce with balanced sweet and earthy flavours rather than strong heat.

components.name: Pilau rice
components.note: Fluffy pilau rice accompanies the curry, giving you a base for the chicken and its creamy tomato sauce.

components.name: Naan bread
components.note: Warm, soft naan bread comes alongside the rice and is useful for mopping up the remaining curry sauce.

taste:
Chicken tikka masala is a mild, creamy curry with a sweet and earthy flavour balance. The tomato-based sauce is enriched with cream, giving it a velvety texture around the tender marinated chicken. Aromatic spices provide flavour without making heat the main attraction. It suits someone looking for a rich curry rather than a strongly spiced meal.

Served hot with fluffy pilau rice and warm, soft naan, the plate offers different textures without moving away from that gentle flavour profile. Spoon the sauce over the rice, then use the naan to mop up what remains. Creaminess is the defining feature, with tomato and spices keeping the flavour balanced.

dietaryGuidance:
Chicken tikka masala is not suitable for vegetarian or vegan diners because it contains chicken, and the sauce also contains cream. No dietary tags are recorded for this dish in our data. The listed allergens are milk and mustard, so diners avoiding either should take particular care.

Do not treat that short list as a complete allergen assessment for every accompaniment or variation. Ask the pub to check its current [allergen information](/allergen-information) before ordering. Any swaps or additions can change the allergens in the meal.

faqs.question: Is Wetherspoons chicken tikka masala spicy?
faqs.answer: Wetherspoons chicken tikka masala is described as mildly spiced, with a rich, creamy sauce rather than a heat-led flavour. Tomato, cream and aromatic spices give it a sweet and earthy balance. It is a suitable choice if you prefer a gentler curry, though individual tolerance for spice varies.
